messages.subject: Hiring multiple postdocs to work in medical data science
messages.subject_clean: Hiring multiple postdocs to work in medical data science
messages.body_plain:
Hi DRUGgies,
The UC Davis DataLab is joining with the UCD Hospital to hire four postdocs for projects in medical data science. These are all two-year positions that will require 1-2 days in-person per week. See the details here:
Applications Open for Postdocs in Translational Data Science at UC Davis <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/2023/06/26/2023-transcend-postdoc-announce/>
datalab.ucdavis.edu <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/2023/06/26/2023-transcend-postdoc-announce/>
 <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/2023/06/26/2023-transcend-postdoc-announce/>

-Wes

messages.subject: Workshop in data visualization
messages.body_plain:
Hi y'all – The MGSA (Mexican graduate association is sponsoring another workshop, this time in data visualization with R. The workshop will be on Thu July 6th from 9am to 2 pm. Feel free to come by and hang out. Workshop is in English, but documentation and help is provided in Spanish and Portuguese as well.
Check out the workshop website for more info on the schedule: https://www.spablo-temporal.network/DataViz-workshop/

registration link: http://bit.ly/data_viz2
